question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

FDH, IGK, LJN, OMQ, ?
solution:
The answer is option 4) RPT 

**SOLUTION:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f4ae28d9ee4072fcf4b1e75c4cf1ea7e531e84c69c7f9b2310b02ab4fe4ee45.png] 

The pattern in the given series is:

 
• **1st character -2 = 2ⁿd character;**
 
• **2ⁿd character + 4 = 3rd character;**
 
• **3rd character + 1 = 1st character of next cluster **

**​**Cluste
